name: ssa-upload
description: Upload original files (PDFs, photos, invoices, sub estimates) into job folders in the classic SSA CRM at crm.ssacapp.com, from a file in Downloads on this computer or a link. Runs on this computer so SSA sees the office connection.

tools.name: ssa_list_job_folders
tools.description: List a job's file folders and which ones the customer can see.

tools.name: ssa_upload_file
tools.description: Upload a file into a folder on an SSA job from a file on this computer, a link, or base64 bytes.

ssa_password.title: SSA password
ssa_password.description: Your crm.ssacapp.com password (stored securely by the Claude app)
